items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: the son of Billy Shaw, Milt, was telling me

ctx.x: And we had talked. He'd said, 'You won't have to work these days and you get paid extra for this.' So they had told us, 'Well, you get a flat salary, so much a week.' So I said, 'No, no, no, no.' I said, 'Look, Lorraine, let's go over it again, the contract.' So we read over the contract again and we found out we were supposed to get extra money for certain days, for so many days a week extra money, so it cost them something like a little over $20,000.00, that they had taken. Well, the son of Billy Shaw, Milt,…
the first one to ride in it." So I said, "Oh, yeah, nice, you know, nice." I hadn't dreamed that it was our money he was going to buy the Oldsmobile with.
